repaired_quantities.A_L1_star: Minimum reusable procedural advice required to satisfy capability-level correctness/quality/reliability and only those latency/cost/resource constraints explicitly load-bearing in the target capability contract.
repaired_quantities.A_L2_star: Minimum reusable procedural advice, if any, required to satisfy absolute project feasibility, ownership, authority/safety, and hard-zero-spend gates.
repaired_quantities.A_L3_star: Reusable procedural information that improves Brain route wall-clock/resource footprint/complexity after L1 and L2 already pass. This is optimization value, not capability-equivalence necessity.

consequence: A speedup heuristic is not automatically a missing Opus capability.

If a Brain-owned zero-advice route eventually achieves the same load-bearing outcome and no task contract imposes the slower resource dimension, failure to match Opus speed does not falsify L1 capability parity.
The user's minimum-wall-clock project objective can still make A_L3 advice highly valuable, but it must not be counted as terminal capability debt.
Only contexts with explicit load-bearing resource/deadline constraints can force resource-speedup advice into A_L1.
scheduler: FIRST classify every alleged resource deficit as L1, L2, or L3.
DELETE L3-only deficits from capability-internalization debt.
For L1/L2 deficits, attack zero-advice sufficiency before admitting positive reusable procedural advice.
Optimize L3 aggressively only after preserving truth about whether it is terminally necessary.
hard_nonclaims: NO CLAIM ZERO_ADVICE IS FAST ENOUGH FOR THE USER'S DESIRED WALL_CLOCK.
NO CLAIM ALL TARGET CAPABILITIES LACK RESOURCE BARS.
NO TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OR OWNERSHIP CREDIT.
